name: Faces App
description: Faces turns Claude into a presentation builder. Create a project, add slides, and write or edit each slide's content, layout, and design tokens; preview any slide as an image; then publish the finished deck to a live URL. Every slide is a React component Claude can refine step by step.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Faces App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Faces App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.faces.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Faces App MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Faces App lists 25 MCP tools, including create_project, create_slides, duplicate_project, finish_slide_editing, get_plugin_docs, get_project, get_project_config, get_project_url, get_slide, get_slide_guide, get_user_state, and list_plugins.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Faces App?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Faces App in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Faces App MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Faces App requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Faces App is developed by Faces. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
